en.text: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣离开那里，来到自己的家乡；门徒也跟从他。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌離開那裏，來到自己的家鄉；門徒也跟從他。

en.text: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

zhSimplified.text: 到了安息日，他在会堂里教训人。众人听见，就甚希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这些事呢？所赐给他的是什么智慧？他手所做的是何等的异能呢？

zhTraditional.text: 到了安息日，他在會堂裏教訓人。眾人聽見，就甚希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這些事呢？所賜給他的是甚麼智慧？他手所做的是何等的異能呢？

en.text: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

zhSimplified.text: 这不是那木匠吗？不是马利亚的儿子雅各、约西、犹大、西门的长兄吗？他妹妹们不也是在我们这里吗？」他们就厌弃他。

footnotes.text: - 6:3 厌弃他：原文是因他跌倒

zhTraditional.text: 這不是那木匠嗎？不是馬利亞的兒子雅各、約西、猶大、西門的長兄嗎？他妹妹們不也是在我們這裏嗎？」他們就厭棄他。

footnotes.text: - 6:3 厭棄他：原文是因他跌倒

en.text: Jesus said to them, “Aprophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他们说：「大凡先知，除了本地、亲属、本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地、親屬、本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」

en.text: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就在那里不得行什么异能，不过按手在几个病人身上，治好他们。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就在那裏不得行甚麼異能，不過按手在幾個病人身上，治好他們。

en.text: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

zhSimplified.text: 他也诧异他们不信，就往周围乡村教训人去了。 （太10·5—15；路9·1—6）

zhTraditional.text: 他也詫異他們不信，就往周圍鄉村教訓人去了。 （太10‧5－15；路9‧1－6）

en.text: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣叫了十二个门徒来，差遣他们两个两个地出去，也赐给他们权柄，制伏污鬼；

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，差遣他們兩個兩個地出去，也賜給他們權柄，制伏污鬼；

en.text: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

zhSimplified.text: 并且嘱咐他们：「行路的时候不要带食物和口袋，腰袋里也不要带钱，除了拐杖以外，什么都不要带；

zhTraditional.text: 並且囑咐他們：「行路的時候不要帶食物和口袋，腰袋裏也不要帶錢，除了柺杖以外，甚麼都不要帶；

en.text: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

zhSimplified.text: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿两件褂子」；

zhTraditional.text: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿兩件褂子」；

en.text: He said to them, “Whereveryou enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

zhSimplified.text: 又对他们说：「你们无论到何处，进了人的家，就住在那里，直到离开那地方。

zhTraditional.text: 又對他們說：「你們無論到何處，進了人的家，就住在那裏，直到離開那地方。

en.text: Whoeverwill not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

zhSimplified.text: 何处的人不接待你们，不听你们，你们离开那里的时候，就把脚上的尘土跺下去，对他们作见证。」

zhTraditional.text: 何處的人不接待你們，不聽你們，你們離開那裏的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去，對他們作見證。」

en.text: They went out and preached that people should repent.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒就出去传道，叫人悔改，

zhTraditional.text: 門徒就出去傳道，叫人悔改，

en.text: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

zhSimplified.text: 又赶出许多的鬼，用油抹了许多病人，治好他们。 （太14·1—12；路9·7—9）

zhTraditional.text: 又趕出許多的鬼，用油抹了許多病人，治好他們。 （太14‧1－12；路9‧7－9）

en.text: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣的名声传扬出来。希律王听见了，就说：「施洗的约翰从死里复活了，所以这些异能由他里面发出来。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌的名聲傳揚出來。希律王聽見了，就說：「施洗的約翰從死裏復活了，所以這些異能由他裏面發出來。」

en.text: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

zhSimplified.text: 但别人说：「是以利亚。」又有人说：「是先知，正像先知中的一位。」

zhTraditional.text: 但別人說：「是以利亞。」又有人說：「是先知，正像先知中的一位。」

en.text: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

zhSimplified.text: 希律听见却说：「是我所斩的约翰，他复活了。」

zhTraditional.text: 希律聽見卻說：「是我所斬的約翰，他復活了。」

en.text: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

zhSimplified.text: 先是希律为他兄弟腓力的妻子希罗底的缘故，差人去拿住约翰，锁在监里，因为希律已经娶了那妇人。

zhTraditional.text: 先是希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，差人去拿住約翰，鎖在監裏，因為希律已經娶了那婦人。

en.text: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

zhSimplified.text: 约翰曾对希律说：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」

zhTraditional.text: 約翰曾對希律說：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」

en.text: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

zhSimplified.text: 于是希罗底怀恨他，想要杀他，只是不能；

zhTraditional.text: 於是希羅底懷恨他，想要殺他，只是不能；

en.text: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

zhSimplified.text: 因为希律知道约翰是义人，是圣人，所以敬畏他，保护他，听他讲论，就多照着行，并且乐意听他。

zhTraditional.text: 因為希律知道約翰是義人，是聖人，所以敬畏他，保護他，聽他講論，就多照着行，並且樂意聽他。

en.text: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

zhSimplified.text: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律摆设筵席，请了大臣和千夫长，并加利利作首领的。

zhTraditional.text: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律擺設筵席，請了大臣和千夫長，並加利利作首領的。

en.text: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 希罗底的女儿进来跳舞，使希律和同席的人都欢喜。王就对女子说：「你随意向我求什么，我必给你。」

zhTraditional.text: 希羅底的女兒進來跳舞，使希律和同席的人都歡喜。王就對女子說：「你隨意向我求甚麼，我必給你。」

en.text: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

zhSimplified.text: 又对她起誓说：「随你向我求什么，就是我国的一半，我也必给你。」

zhTraditional.text: 又對她起誓說：「隨你向我求甚麼，就是我國的一半，我也必給你。」

en.text: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

zhSimplified.text: 她就出去对她母亲说：「我可以求什么呢？」她母亲说：「施洗约翰的头。」

zhTraditional.text: 她就出去對她母親說：「我可以求甚麼呢？」她母親說：「施洗約翰的頭。」

en.text: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

zhSimplified.text: 她就急忙进去见王，求他说：「我愿王立时把施洗约翰的头放在盘子里给我。」

zhTraditional.text: 她就急忙進去見王，求他說：「我願王立時把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏給我。」

en.text: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

zhSimplified.text: 王就甚忧愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辞，

zhTraditional.text: 王就甚憂愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辭，

en.text: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

zhSimplified.text: 随即差一个护卫兵，吩咐拿约翰的头来。护卫兵就去，在监里斩了约翰，

zhTraditional.text: 隨即差一個護衛兵，吩咐拿約翰的頭來。護衛兵就去，在監裏斬了約翰，

en.text: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

zhSimplified.text: 把头放在盘子里，拿来给女子，女子就给她母亲。

zhTraditional.text: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給女子，女子就給她母親。

en.text: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

zhSimplified.text: 约翰的门徒听见了，就来把他的尸首领去，葬在坟墓里。 （太14·13—21；路9·10—17；约6·1—14）

zhTraditional.text: 約翰的門徒聽見了，就來把他的屍首領去，葬在墳墓裏。 （太14‧13－21；路9‧10－17；約6‧1－14）

en.text: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

zhSimplified.text: 使徒聚集到耶稣那里，将一切所做的事、所传的道全告诉他。

zhTraditional.text: 使徒聚集到耶穌那裏，將一切所做的事、所傳的道全告訴他。

en.text: He said to them, “Comeaway into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

zhSimplified.text: 他就说：「你们来，同我暗暗地到旷野地方去歇一歇。」这是因为来往的人多，他们连吃饭也没有工夫。

zhTraditional.text: 他就說：「你們來，同我暗暗地到曠野地方去歇一歇。」這是因為來往的人多，他們連吃飯也沒有工夫。

en.text: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就坐船，暗暗地往旷野地方去。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就坐船，暗暗地往曠野地方去。

en.text: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

zhSimplified.text: 众人看见他们去，有许多认识他们的，就从各城步行，一同跑到那里，比他们先赶到了。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人看見他們去，有許多認識他們的，就從各城步行，一同跑到那裏，比他們先趕到了。

en.text: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣出来，见有许多的人，就怜悯他们，因为他们如同羊没有牧人一般，于是开口教训他们许多道理。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，因為他們如同羊沒有牧人一般，於是開口教訓他們許多道理。

en.text: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

zhSimplified.text: 天已经晚了，门徒进前来，说：「这是野地，天已经晚了，

zhTraditional.text: 天已經晚了，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，天已經晚了，

en.text: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

zhSimplified.text: 请叫众人散开，他们好往四面乡村里去，自己买什么吃。」

zhTraditional.text: 請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裏去，自己買甚麼吃。」

en.text: But he answered them, “Yougive them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

footnotes.text: 6:37 200 denarii was about 7 or 8 months wages for an agricultural laborer.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「你们给他们吃吧。」门徒说：「我们可以去买二十两银子的饼给他们吃吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「你們給他們吃吧。」門徒說：「我們可以去買二十兩銀子的餅給他們吃嗎？」

en.text: He said to them, “Howmany loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们有多少饼，可以去看看。」他们知道了，就说：「五个饼，两条鱼。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅，可以去看看。」他們知道了，就說：「五個餅，兩條魚。」

en.text: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣吩咐他们，叫众人一帮一帮地坐在青草地上。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌吩咐他們，叫眾人一幫一幫地坐在青草地上。

en.text: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

zhSimplified.text: 众人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。

en.text: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开饼，递给门徒，摆在众人面前，也把那两条鱼分给众人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前，也把那兩條魚分給眾人。

en.text: They all ate and were filled.

zhSimplified.text: 他们都吃，并且吃饱了。

zhTraditional.text: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了。

en.text: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒就把碎饼碎鱼收拾起来，装满了十二个篮子。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒就把碎餅碎魚收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。

en.text: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边伯赛大去，等他叫众人散开。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊伯賽大去，等他叫眾人散開。

en.text: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

zhSimplified.text: 他既辞别了他们，就往山上去祷告。

zhTraditional.text: 他既辭別了他們，就往山上去禱告。

en.text: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

zhSimplified.text: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶稣独自在岸上；

zhTraditional.text: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶穌獨自在岸上；

en.text: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

zhSimplified.text: 看见门徒因风不顺，摇橹甚苦。夜里约有四更天，就在海面上走，往他们那里去，意思要走过他们去。

zhTraditional.text: 看見門徒因風不順，搖櫓甚苦。夜裏約有四更天，就在海面上走，往他們那裏去，意思要走過他們去。

en.text: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

zhSimplified.text: 但门徒看见他在海面上走，以为是鬼怪，就喊叫起来；

zhTraditional.text: 但門徒看見他在海面上走，以為是鬼怪，就喊叫起來；

en.text: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’tbe afraid.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们都看见了他，且甚惊慌。耶稣连忙对他们说：「你们放心！是我，不要怕！」

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們都看見了他，且甚驚慌。耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心！是我，不要怕！」

en.text: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

zhSimplified.text: 于是到他们那里，上了船，风就住了；他们心里十分惊奇。

zhTraditional.text: 於是到他們那裏，上了船，風就住了；他們心裏十分驚奇。

en.text: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

zhSimplified.text: 这是因为他们不明白那分饼的事，心里还是愚顽。 （太14·34—36）

zhTraditional.text: 這是因為他們不明白那分餅的事，心裏還是愚頑。 （太14‧34－36）

en.text: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

zhSimplified.text: 既渡过去，来到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，

zhTraditional.text: 既渡過去，來到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，

en.text: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

zhSimplified.text: 一下船，众人认得是耶稣，

zhTraditional.text: 一下船，眾人認得是耶穌，

en.text: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

zhSimplified.text: 就跑遍那一带地方，听见他在何处，便将有病的人用褥子抬到那里。

zhTraditional.text: 就跑遍那一帶地方，聽見他在何處，便將有病的人用褥子抬到那裏。

en.text: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

zhSimplified.text: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或村中，或城里，或乡间，他们都将病人放在街市上，求耶稣只容他们摸他的衣裳 子；凡摸着的人就都好了。

zhTraditional.text: 凡耶穌所到的地方，或村中，或城裏，或鄉間，他們都將病人放在街市上，求耶穌只容他們摸他的衣裳繸子；凡摸着的人就都好了。
